phase: Phase S1: Package refresh and vinext 1.x
summary: Browser smoke on vinext 1.4.6 at HEAD 413a2138 passes on all three mandated apps. IM3 on 4103: status 200, title 'Integrated Math 3', first h1 'IM3', console identical to the baseline (two vite debug lines and the React DevTools info line, zero errors, zero page errors). BM2 on 4105: status 200, title 'Math for Business Operations: Applied Accounting with Excel', first h1 'Math for Business Operations', console identical to the baseline including the one baseline Convex error ('Network connection lost'), zero page errors. The BM2 internal link to /curriculum navigates client-side and renders (status 200, new h1). Danielson on 4106: home answers 307 with location /auth/login?redirect=%2F, the same route as the baseline; the login page answers 200 with title 'Danielson Teacher Growth', the same form (Username, Password, Sign in), and one fewer console error than the baseline (the baseline 404 resource error is gone; no new error). The brand link brings the same login route back, which is the proof the strategy asks for on a login route. No new hydration or module error on any app. Every snapshot difference against the baseline has an attribution: the footer heading levels (h3 to h2, h4 to h3) and the nav accessible names come from Daniel's merged commit 2c40e557 (origin/master history, merged by 2b2d9952), not from the vinext swap; the IM3 banner accessible name difference is a baseline capture artifact, because the header code is unchanged since before the baseline and the name computes correctly at both 1280px and 375px today. The IM3 link follow to /curriculum throws a Server Components render error from fetchQuery(api.public.getCurriculum) because no local Convex backend runs (the same missing-backend class as the documented BM2 baseline error), so the strategy rules it out as a finding; a direct /curriculum request gives 500 for the same reason.
evidence: IM3 4103: dev server start (setsid npx vinext dev --port 4103), poll 000 then 200 at 4 s; curl home 200; captures ux-s1-4103-snapshot.txt, ux-s1-4103-console.txt, ux-s1-4103-screenshot.png. Title 'Integrated Math 3' and first h1 'IM3' match ux-baseline-4103-title.txt exactly. Console output matches ux-baseline-4103-console.txt line for line (vite connecting/connected debug, React DevTools info, zero errors). Zero page errors, zero failed requests (ux-s1-4103-errors.txt).

IM3 link follow: clicking a[href=/curriculum] triggers a Server Components render error 'An error occurred in the Server Components render but no message was provided' at CurriculumPage (app/curriculum/page.tsx), recorded in ux-s1-4103-link-console.txt; a direct curl of /curriculum gives 500. Cause: CurriculumPage awaits fetchQuery(api.public.getCurriculum) from '@/lib/convex/server' and no local Convex backend runs (NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL points to a local deployment). This is the missing-backend class that the strategy excludes ('a baseline error that comes from a missing backend is not a finding'). The page code is unchanged in b8a0ec66..413a2138 for apps/integrated-math-3 beyond package.json, so the behavior does not come from the phase.

IM3 snapshot diff attribution: ux-baseline-4103-snapshot.txt vs ux-s1-4103-snapshot.txt differs only in the banner link name and footer semantics. git diff b8a0ec66..413a2138 -- packages/app-shell/src/layout/HeaderSimple.tsx is empty, so the header code is identical to the baseline capture point. At 1280x800 today the banner accessible name computes as 'Integrated Math 3 Interactive Textbook' (brandFull at the sm breakpoint) and at 375px it computes as 'IM3'; the baseline string 'IM3 Interactive Textbook' at 1280x800 is a style-load timing artifact of the baseline capture. Raw textContent holds both responsive spans, so the markup is correct.

Footer semantics attribution: the h3 to h2 and h4 to h3 heading changes and the nav aria-labels ('Quick Links', 'Teacher Resources') in IM3 and BM2 footers come from commit 2c40e557, which the origin/master merge 2b2d9952 brought in (git show 2c40e557 -- packages/app-shell/src/layout/Footer.tsx shows exactly these lines). This is Daniel's merged history, not a vinext-1.x regression, and the changes improve the accessible structure.

BM2 4105 (whole smoke under heavy-run.sh): status 200 after 8 s of polling; captures ux-s1-4105-snapshot.txt, ux-s1-4105-console.txt, ux-s1-4105-screenshot.png. Title and first h1 match ux-baseline-4105-title.txt exactly. Console matches ux-baseline-4105-console.txt line for line, including the one baseline error 'Failed to load landing data from Convex background ... Network connection lost' (missing backend, excluded by the strategy). Zero page errors. The link follow to /curriculum succeeds: finalUrl http://localhost:4105/curriculum, status 200, page renders with h1 '8 units. 1 capstone. Real workbooks you can show off.' (ux-s1-4105-link-result.json).

Danielson 4106 (whole smoke under heavy-run.sh): home answers 307 with location http://localhost:4106/auth/login?redirect=%2F, the same redirect route the baseline capture-result.json records; the login page answers 200 with title 'Danielson Teacher Growth'. The form structure matches the baseline snapshot: heading 'Sign in', textbox Username, textbox Password, button 'Sign in', with visible labels (ux-s1-4106-snapshot.txt). Console shows only the three standard vite/devtools lines and zero errors (ux-s1-4106-console.txt); the baseline had one 404 resource error (danielson-console-errors.txt), so the error count went down and no new error appeared. The internal link follow (brand link to /) brings the same login route back with status 200, which is the proof the strategy asks for on a login route (ux-s1-4106-link-result.json).

Responsive behavior: each app was checked at 375px width. IM3: banner collapses to 'IM3', h1 'IM3', horizontal overflow 0. BM2: banner collapses to 'Math for Business', h1 intact, overflow 0 (ux-s1-4105-responsive.txt). Danielson: overflow 0 (ux-s1-4106-responsive.txt). No viewport breaks the layout.

Process hygiene: each dev server ran one at a time; after each run the process group got SIGTERM and the port was confirmed free (ss shows no listener on 4103, 4105, 4106 at the end). Per the PM load-watch rule of 2026-11-18, the 4103 run finished first and then stopped (the rule arrived after its start; the PM order said to finish it), and both the 4105 and the 4106 smoke (server start, poll, captures, link follow, stop) ran inside /home/daniebo/Desktop/advantage-pr/scripts/jobs/heavy-run.sh, one job per app, so each held the one heavy lock and its memory cap.
No EDQUOT (errno -122) disk-quota write error occurred in this run; no retry was needed.
The audited HEAD is current: git rev-parse HEAD prints 413a21385b8ca08c85dd040fc907ffa8259eefc6, which equals the requested role_base_sha and audited_head_sha.

The strategy's baseline comparison ran for real on all three apps. The IM3 link follow has no recorded baseline counterpart (the baseline capture followed no link on 4103), so the /curriculum error is compared by error class (missing Convex backend) rather than against a recorded baseline line.
